changes: No substantive changes. Notes now say that the era is inferred rather than stated, and that 'dhaṭakarpara' is a scribal slip for 'ghaṭakarpara'.

notes: The colophon belongs to the Ghaṭakarparakāvya and its ṭīkā ('dhaṭakarpara' is a slip for 'ghaṭakarpara') and names no persons. The era is not stated. I read it as Vikrama because of the Nepali-style abbreviation 'mi. kā. kṛ.' (miti kārtika kṛṣṇa) and because reading it as NS 1920 (about 2800 CE) is impossible. That gives VS 1920 kārtika kṛṣṇa 13, a Monday ('caṃ' = candravāra), around October–November 1863 CE. This does not match the catalogue fields (title Caurapañcāśikā, Samvat 1678 kārtika vadi 12 maṅgalavāra, donor Netrānanda miśra). Those fields probably describe a different manuscript or another part of the reel. Netrānanda is not in this colophon, so I have not recorded him.
